annotations.title: Suggest an email-reading rule (hack) from an example message

description: Suggests a hack (a template that reads one kind of message) from an example email or JSON body, for a track. It's checked against similar messages waiting in the track's Inbox. A fallback: write the template yourself first and check it with test_hack, and call this only after two tries fail. Each call uses one of the person's daily AI suggestions, and assistants get 3 a day. Check the answer with test_hack, then save it with save_hack.

example.description: The whole message as received or forwarded, with its From and Subject lines if you have them.

hackId.description: To fix a hack that stopped matching: its id. Its fields and senders are kept, so its columns stay mapped.

senders.description: Addresses or domains this kind of message comes from, like "chase.com".
